evals.prompt: Using the fixed original supplied pair and zero-spend job, prepare one Claude agent draft. Return final hashes, complete diff, real offline receipts and separate quality/live limits.
evals.expected_output: Only the allowed draft path changes, the floor and grants match, required bindings are present and independent quality/live proof remains unverified.

evals.prompt: Repair only the description in the supplied native draft while retaining the complete pinned baseline, including unrelated.md. The target and constraints are fixed.
evals.expected_output: The unchanged note appears with its original hash, all changed bytes fit update scope, stale evidence blocks acceptance and no live or publication action occurs.

comparison.pair: Same immutable job and input bytes with and without this Skill
comparison.control: Unrelated task with equal budget; Skill should not broaden scope
comparison.execution: unverified; maintainer must separately authorize account, prompts and cost limits
